note: Passive registry. Fields are ids, files, titles and human-readable triggers only. The skeleton decides WHEN to read a section; nothing here does.

sections.title: Cross-check findings against the stressor matrix
sections.trigger: any review run on a system that has had a stressor analysis - classifying each finding by whether the matrix should have caught it

sections.title: Artifact consistency - documents drifting from each other
sections.trigger: any review of a design with more than a handful of ADRs, and whenever triage sends a finding here rather than to the matrix

sections.title: Architecture and data dimensions
sections.trigger: running /restack-design-review architecture or data, or the architecture and data passes of a complete review

sections.title: API and security dimensions
sections.trigger: running /restack-design-review api or security, or the API and security passes of a complete review

sections.title: Performance and scale dimension
sections.trigger: running /restack-design-review performance, or the performance pass of a complete review

sections.title: Writing findings and the review report
sections.trigger: writing up any review - severity, evidence standards, and the report format

sections.title: Outside opinion - cross-model second read
sections.trigger: the design under review is a one-way door and an adversarial outside read is worth the cost
